source_of_truth: Riviera brochure/source count alignment plus locked Kuschi kitchen production standards. Brochure ranges stay visible; kitchen production counts are fixed for prep efficiency.

rules.brochure_vs_kitchen: Use brochure_count or brochure_range for client/source alignment. Use kitchen_production_count for prep sheets, order builds and production targets.
rules.hot_nibble_standard: Single hot nibble platter converts brochure range 20-25 pieces to fixed kitchen production count 24 pieces.
rules.mixed_hot_nibble_standard: Mixed hot nibble box/platter converts brochure range 40-50 pieces to fixed kitchen production count 48 pieces, split 12 each across four items.
rules.platter_standard: Cold platter counts must not silently use 40-piece batch yields when the published platter service count is 12 or 24 pieces. Built-in recipe yields may remain batch yields, but service variants must show platter service counts.

checks.source_note: Scone platter source count is 12 pieces per platter.
Sweet slices/cakes platter source count is 12 pieces per platter.
Croissant platter source count is 12 pieces per platter.
Sandwich platter source count is 24 points from 6 whole sandwiches.
Wrap platter source count is 12 pieces per platter.
Mini brioche roll platter source count is 12 rolls per platter.
Treat as sandwich platter logic unless a newer source splits this as a separate 12-piece roll/brioche item.
Mixed hot nibble source range is 40-50 pieces; locked kitchen production count is 48 pieces, 12 each of four items.
Wake/funeral mixed hot nibble source range is 40-50 pieces; locked kitchen production count is 48 pieces.
Single hot nibble platter source range is 20-25 pieces; locked kitchen production count is 24 pieces.
